title: 2-D Median
text: 2-D Median values of input array, 1 input, 1 output, {Find the median value over} sets Dimension in which to compute median Entire; {Sort algorithm} sets the algorithm to sort input array, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input array scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output median values scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Sort algorithm
params.values: Algorithm to sort input array Quick sort (default) | Insertion sort

params.name: Find the median value over
params.values: Dimension in which to compute median Entire input (default) | Each row | Each column | Specified dimension

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
